summary: M009 is implemented and enabled for fresh Studio UI runs. Its compensated three-component norm preserves 1,884 sampled physical checkpoints across 38 Node scenarios plus mass/load edits, and 240 browser checkpoint samples. Controlled CPU throughput is 1.387× for the default press, 1.397× for the aluminum-draw preset, 1.469× for canopy and 1.359× for bridge; all controls and legacy performance gates pass. These are physics-step measurements, not browser FPS. Forty-two production tests, TypeScript and native WebGPU run/replay/pause/reset checks pass. M001 and the combined M003/M004/M020 trial were rejected and retained; M018, M064 and M097 now have a qualified analytical working-tool query and normal-response foundation: 4,800 mesh distance samples and 3,680 complete sweeps pass, with full Studio integration still open. Controlled query throughput is 1.363 times the preceding analytical candidate across 2,395 common-resolved oblique cases, with all tool, unchanged-control and p95 gates passing; this is a standalone query measurement. The other 92 entries remain proposals. The original engine roadmap status is unchanged.
